body:
Hello Guys???? and kylo,

I am doing a suggestion

I came back to avicus from a 4 month break. I saw that all of the kits are free and don't need to be unlocked. I honestly think that is good but ruins the try-hard trying to get kits. I think we should make it so you have to buy walls kits like all 100 credits or something
